typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and thin, horizontal serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (similar to Bodoni or Didot), which was the standard for formal French academic and scientific publishing in the 19th century.
